findings.title: Error-handler parameter conflicts with process event arguments
findings.description: `src/index.ts:171-172` registers `handleError` directly as both process event listeners. Their second arguments are an origin string and a Promise—not exit codes. The new parameter forwards these to `process.exit`, causing another exception instead of clean termination. Reproduced on Node 22. Wrap listeners with `(err) => handleError(err)` and add regression tests.

findings.title: Fix mode can report success while validation errors remain
findings.description: `remaining` contains only original findings whose fixes failed or were unavailable. However, `validateFrontmatter` returns immediately when `docType` is missing. Fixing an inferred `docType` therefore reveals previously unchecked required fields, yet this command exits successfully without checking them. Revalidate modified files before determining the exit status; test a document missing both `docType` and `dateCreated`.

findings.title: Missing dateUpdated is backfilled with the creation date
findings.description: The schema generates a missing-`dateUpdated` fix using `dateCreated`. The writer explicitly preserves the supplied value when updating `dateUpdated`, ignoring the fourth-argument stamp. Consequently, this command can write an old creation date despite modifying the file today—and overwrite today’s stamp from an earlier fix. Use the run date for this field and test the resulting file contents.
